jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, Enterprise Platform
jobs.description: This a Full Remote job, the offer is available from: Europe, European Union, EMEA, Poland Working at Atlassian Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity. Your Future Org At Atlassian, Product Management is a team sport. We work closely with engineering, design, and go-to-market teams to build products that help millions of people do their best work. We care deeply about solving real customer problems, and we’re energized by the possibilities AI and new technology bring. If you're someone who loves turning insight into impact - and wants to shape the future of modern work - we’d love to meet you. Your Future Team You’ll join a team helping the world’s largest and most complex enterprises thrive on Atlassian Cloud - modernizing business-critical workflows, continuously optimizing their environments, and unlocking cloud-native and AI capabilities. Building on existing foundations, you’ll discover and validate the next high-value platform opportunities, establish an evolving area of product ownership, and partner with engineering and design to turn shared customer needs into scalable products. • Shape an emerging platform opportunity. Explore how complex enterprises modernize, optimize, and scale on Atlassian Cloud. Establish a product vision and progressively define the scope, priorities, and roadmap for an evolving area of ownership. • Discover the problems worth solving. Work directly with enterprise customers and customer-facing teams to uncover unmet needs, challenge assumptions, and distinguish recurring platform opportunities from customer-specific requests. • Turn ambiguity into product direction. Form hypotheses, assess customer and business value, and partner with engineering and design to test potential solutions. Make evidence-based recommendations about where to invest, and where not to. • Translate insight into scalable capabilities. Develop promising opportunities into reusable platform capabilities, automation, and cloud-native reference patterns that address shared enterprise and industry needs, helping customers continuously improve without depending on bespoke intervention. • Take validated opportunities from discovery into delivery. Own product decisions, prioritization, and outcomes as the opportunity matures, working with engineering, design, and architecture to launch, learn, and iterate. • Build alignment. Earn support across product, engineering, and customer-facing teams, clarify boundaries with adjacent products, and establish shared ownership where solutions span teams. • Define what success looks like. Establish meaningful outcomes as the product direction takes shape, using customer evidence and product adoption to refine the strategy and guide further investment. Minimum Qualifications • 8+ years of product management experience leading complex B2B enterprise platforms, cloud infrastructure, or enterprise SaaS capabilities at scale. • A track record of navigating ambiguous problem spaces, identifying and validating new product opportunities, and building a focused strategy and roadmap as evidence emerges. • A strong understanding of enterprise architecture and the technical and organizational challenges of modernizing and continuously optimizing complex enterprise environments on Cloud. • A track record of turning bespoke customer requirements, field escalations, or professional-services insights into scalable platform capabilities, automation, or reusable frameworks. • Demonstrated ability to build credibility with senior technology executives and influence decisions in large organizations. • Experience leading strategy and execution across engineering, architecture, design, customer-facing teams, and partners without relying on formal authority. Preferred Qualifications •

jobs.description: About the team The Consumer Bank Network team helps people do more with their bank accounts. We build consumer experiences for connecting financial accounts and making payments across Stripe, spanning Financial Connections and Link. We make these experiences simple, secure, and trustworthy. We combine product design, experimentation, and personalization to reduce friction, improve conversion, and help consumers discover and adopt payment methods that meet their needs. For businesses, this means easier customer onboarding and better payment experiences. This is both an application and platform team: in addition to the thousands of merchants integrating the Financial Connections UX, more than a dozen teams across Stripe also rely on Financial Connections to serve their users. Link is used by more than 300 million consumers. You'll build consumer experiences within that ecosystem, where small improvements in conversion can help more people connect accounts, make purchases, and get paid. What you'll do You'll own the strategy and roadmap for consumer growth, conversion, and payment method adoption across Financial Connections and Link. You'll work across the consumer journey, from connecting a financial account to completing a purchase, setting up a subscription, managing your finances with your agent of choice, or receiving a payout. This role combines a high bar for consumer product craft with a disciplined approach to growth. You'll turn user research and funnel analysis into ideas, work closely with Engineering, Design, and Data Science to test them, and scale what works. You'll shape both the everyday details of the experience and larger changes to how people discover and use financial products. Understand differences across consumer cohorts and use cases, and distinguish product impact from changes in traffic mix. • Work with Engineering to improve reliability and experience quality, resolve friction, and make it easier to deliver and evaluate product changes. • Lead work across Link, Payments, Financial Connections, and cross-functional teams such as Partnerships, Risk, and Legal. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Attorney Experience (Remote - PST/MST)
jobs.description: About Rocket Lawyer Founded in 2008, we believe everyone deserves to be legally protected. In one seamless experience that combines trusted legal AI and the right attorney for each legal matter, Rocket Lawyer members have always-on access to affordable legal guidance and services they need. To date we've helped over 30 million consumers and small businesses get the legal help they need and are now expanding the team in order to bring affordable legal protection to even more. About your role Have a passion for helping people through technology - especially AI? Join Rocket Lawyer as we disrupt the legal industry and advance our mission to make the law affordable and simple. You'll work at the forefront of agentic AI product development, building and launching cutting-edge products for attorneys. Sound exciting? We'd love for you to join us! Your role will be to own the end-to-end delivery of our Legal Platform, the product that enables attorneys in Rocket Lawyer's network to deliver legal services through our on-demand marketplace. Today, much of the legal work between attorneys and customers happens off platform - phone calls, emails, and file sharing. Your job will be to bring that experience on-platform through streamlined web conferencing, privileged workspaces, and secure collaboration tools for documents and messaging. Creating a delightful experience for both attorneys and customers is essential. Attorneys already love Rocket Lawyer because it enables them to practice their craft on their own terms - without business development, invoicing, nor collections. Now we're equipping them with cutting edge legal technology and AI powered tools that enable them to do their job more efficiently than ever. How you will make a difference day to day Product Strategy and Vision • Drive Product strategy and execution for our Legal Platform. • Develop a deep understand of the needs of our network attorneys through quantitative and qualitative research. • Passionately represent the voice of the customer (attorneys) while building products aligned with our product vision. • Lead the ideation, development, and launch of products for our customers. Data Driven Product Development: • Define and analyze metrics to measure business impacts • Prioritize features using data-driven analysis, business insights, and sound judgment. • Develop and deliver a roadmap for our Legal Platform product capabilities. • Understand and report on the direct revenue implications of product decisions. Design and Engineering Team Collaboration • Collaborate with a cross-functional team of Design, User Experience, Engineering, QA, and Content to bring product experiments to market. • Develop a deep understanding of the marketplace and competitive environment. What you'll need • 8-10 years of software Product Development experience, ideally with B2B or B2C SaaS products. • At least 4 years in SaaS (Productivity, Project Management, Collaboration, Workflow) specific product management. • Ability to combine strong product sense with business acumen to deliver positive outcomes for both customers and the business. • Passionate about our mission. • Demonstrated ability to think critically and problem-solve. • Excellent communication skills. • An ownership mentality. • Ability to engage in respectful debate and arrive at "win-win" decisions. • A bias for action. • Excitement to celebrate and win as a team. • Self-aware and a growth mindset. A bonus if you have • Experience building or launching products that leverage agentic AI systems. • Experience in the legal technology industry.
